reviews.author: MUNEESH KUMAR
reviews.title: Very Happy with the Purchase
reviews.body: I’ve been using the Urban Company Native M1 Water Purifier for around 10 days, and my experience so far has been very good\. The design looks premium and modern, and the build quality feels impressive\. The 8\-litre storage capacity is quite convenient for daily household use\. Its 10\-stage purification system with RO, UV, copper and alkaline technology is another big plus\. I also appreciate the 2\-year warranty and the promise of no regular servicing during this period\. Overall, it’s a well\-designed purifier with useful features and excellent value\. Very satisfied with my purchase so far
